Lina Gomez: Quick heads-up 12 NovaCart signed an agreement for a Marketplace listing + 4-week Dedicated pilot for peak checkout traffic. They care about PCI and low-latency recommendations :tada:
Ari Shah: Who's owning AE/CS for onboarding? We should align exec comms if it's strategic.
Lina Gomez: @Ari I'll lead the kickoff and then hand to CS after week 2. Onboarding owner: Tom Becker.
Tom Becker: I'll own technical onboarding. Plan: week 0 baseline on Hosted, week 1-4 Dedicated pool (burst capacity). Targets: P95 < 110ms for recs, 15% token cost saving via prefix cache.
Nora Li: Marketing: Love this. Can we get a customer quote + permission for a Marketplace spotlight if pilot metrics hit? We can draft a co-marketing plan with legal-approved language.
Lina Gomez: Yes, co-marketing clause in SOW. Nora, can you draft a 1-pager that calls out latency + cost wins?
Tom Becker: Infra notes: NovaCart will use Redwood Private in their VPC for checkout calls, Hosted for analytics. Need KMS key flow and a sample network policy. I'll attach ref arch.
ops-bot: Action: Capacity request created (#PRJ-7781). Requested: Dedicated pool (3x A10) for 4 weeks. Approval ETA 12 hours.
Ari Shah: Legal ask 7: confirm data processing addendum signed? Lina: yes, DPA signed last week.
Lina Gomez: Kickoff scheduled Tue 10:00 PT. Tom please share the baseline runbook and the SOW link in this thread after you push it.
Tom Becker: SOW draft uploaded: https://redwood.workspace/docs/novacart/sow (comments open). Baseline run command we'll use:
```
# run baseline load
wrk -t8 -c200 -d60s http://api.redwood.test/generate
model: recs-lite-v1
batching: smart
cache: prefix
qps_target: 150
```
Nora Li: Adding PR/sales comms: I'll prepare an internal one-pager and a draft marketplace blurb. If pilot hits P95 <110ms at 2 weeks, we ask for a short quote.
Lina Gomez: Great work team. This is a solid marketplace+private motion signal. I'll post an exec note after kickoff with ROI targets and next steps. :rocket:
